def _validate_request(data, signature):
    """Raise ``PermissionError`` unless the request is authenticated.

    Missing and invalid signatures deliberately produce the same error so that
    callers cannot use the response to distinguish authentication failures.
    Every request is verified; there are no caller-controlled verification
    bypasses.
    """
    if signature is None or not verify_signature(data, signature):
        raise PermissionError("invalid signature")


def handle_request(data, signature):
    """Authenticate a request, then process its payload."""
    _validate_request(data, signature)
    return process(data)
